source: Unchanged FM17 source selection, DC lambda and rho; use selected grid BEFORE tail adjustment
trigger: Draw target margin -handicap has competition rank <=2 among positive margin atoms
draw_probability: P(target)/sum(top three margin atoms including all boundary ties)
win_loss_probability: Remaining mass split in full original right:left mass ratio
ties: Absolute tolerance 1e-12, include entire top-three boundary tie group; no arbitrary side preference
few_atoms: Use all available positive atoms if fewer than three
score_sync: Preserve within-W/D/L score proportions; output is handicap-specific expert reweighting, not a newly fitted DC distribution
cutoff: Explicit cutoff and shared temporal_learning evidence context binding alpha_input and alpha_code required
